name: cueline-desktop
description: A transparent, always-on-top teleprompter with click-through controls and best-effort capture protection.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cueline listens only when you start voice follow so it can keep the script aligned with your delivery.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Cueline can process consented session audio locally when you explicitly start a private session.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Cueline uses macOS media selection only when you explicitly choose to process consented system audio.
